newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares start down, set for further falls.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares start down, set for further falls.

text.p: Danish share prices opened a smidgen lower on Friday, with dealers seeing further falls ahead as the corporate interim result season winds up.
"It looks like we are going to see more falls today, with company results in focus again," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had lost 0.09 point to 119.18 at 0710 gmt, having closed 0.63 point lower on Thursday.
